name: intraday_rvol_breakout_tight
notes: Selective variant of intraday_rvol_breakout. The loose version matched 16.5% of sessions — a screen, not a signal — and returned the cost. This demands a genuine volume event: 2x a normal full day's volume already traded, a 5x one-minute volume spike, a real move off the open, and price pinned at the high of day. Tests whether selectivity separates anything, given the project's finding that the extreme-volume tail is where the disasters live.
